title: upload_blob response limit is hardcoded, ignores ClientConfig
description: blob.rs defines UPLOAD_RESPONSE_LIMIT = 1 MiB as a private constant unrelated to ClientConfig. ClientConfig has max_session_body, max_call_body, max_download_body but no max_upload_body. A caller reading the ClientConfig docs expects all limits to be configurable; the upload response limit is silently unconfigurable. Future addition of max_upload_body to ClientConfig is a struct-literal breaking change (compounding issue JMAP-8kf.3). The inconsistency will also generate contributor PRs trying to 'fix' it.
